literal_meaning: ভাগ্যের জাল ছেঁড়া (fate's net is torn)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাগ্যে শিকে ছেঁড়া হয়েছে, তাই চাকরিটা পেয়েছি।
এবার ভাগ্যে শিকে ছেঁড়া, সব ঝামেলা শেষ।
example_sentences_in_english: The net of fate has torn, so I got the job.
This time the net of fate has torn, all troubles are over.
note: The idiom metaphorically suggests breaking free from the constraints of fate, allowing good luck to prevail, often linked to rural imagery of nets in fishing or trapping.
